key_findings: Hyperoside protected TNF-α-stimulated human nucleus pulposus cells from inflammation, ECM degradation and ER stress-mediated apoptosis.
Effects were reversed by SIRT1 inhibitor EX527 and Nrf2 inhibitor ML385.
